cards.name: Nicotine
cards.flavor: Calms the nerves. Shortens the rest.
cards.notes: Potion: draw 2 now, into this Day's hand (the user, 2026-10-17: a potion that draws draws at once).
cards.picture: A crumpled pack of cigarettes on a café table, one lit in the ashtray, a ribbon of smoke curling into a question mark.

cards.name: Stimulant Drug
cards.flavor: Focus, energy, and a heart rate of 190.
cards.notes: Potion: target creature +2 Attack this Day.
cards.picture: A pill organizer with every compartment full of the same blue pill, a student's desk behind it buried in energy drink cans at 4 a.m.

cards.name: Superglue
cards.picture: A tube of superglue squeezed over a cracked vase, two fingers already stuck to it.

cards.name: Soylent
cards.flavor: All the nutrients. None of the joy.
cards.picture: A beige bottle of meal-replacement drink on an empty dining table, a lonely fork beside it.

cards.name: Flamethrower
cards.notes: Potion: 4 damage to target creature or player.
cards.picture: A flamethrower with a novelty-store price tag, a jet of fire roaring out of it across a garden barbecue.

cards.name: Eject Button
cards.notes: Potion: target creature of yours goes back to your hand, with the next Day's.
cards.picture: A big red button under a flip-up cover on a cockpit panel, a pilot's seat already rocketing out of the frame.

cards.name: Stealth Suit
cards.flavor: Comes in black, darker black, and invisible.
cards.picture: An empty mannequin in a shop window wearing a suit you can only see by its outline, the price tag floating in mid-air.

cards.name: Creatine
cards.notes: Potion: target creature +1 Attack and +1 Health.
cards.picture: A giant tub of white powder with a flexing cartoon bicep on its label, a scoop sticking out of it.
